class: One decision kept in three lists: the wait after hand-over did not read the site's own confirmation words
symptom: Premier Health (Eightfold), 1 October: the owner pressed Submit and the site confirmed it; the run kept checking Gmail and the status stayed 'ready to submit'.
site: Eightfold and any site whose confirmation wording was only in its adapter
root_cause: 'Is this a confirmation?' was decided by browser_automation._CONFIRMATION_PHRASES (the wait), page_agent.CONFIRMATION_TEXT (the reading agent) and each adapter's confirmation_phrases -- and the wait never read the adapter's.
why_tests_missed: Each list was tested on its own; no test compared them or used an adapter-only phrase in the wait.
fix: confirmation.py holds the patterns and says_received(text, site_phrases); page_agent imports them and submission_confirmed uses them with the site adapter's phrases. _CONFIRMATION_PHRASES is removed.
prevention: One module per decision; a site adapter's words are an input to it, never a separate check.
